model_configuration: Uses existing OpenCode model; no API credentials or provider changes

options.max_cells: 1..100000, default 10000; shared budget across selected sheets

inspect.workflow: Inspect available_sheets first; then use sheets and start_row/start_col to retrieve later windows. Check requested/sample ranges and truncation. Cache freshness is never verified.

resource_limits.note: All budgets apply together. Larger/denser documents fail explicitly rather than silently parse partially.

output_notes.formula_records: formula_type and formula_metadata preserve normal/array/dataTable semantics; formula expression is text or null when none exists. Cached values are unverified.
output_notes.sheet_kind: worksheet has a cell grid; chartsheet has dimensions=null and no cell window, but chart/drawing relationships remain.
output_notes.library_warnings: Unsupported extensions/header/footer/etc warnings are captured. Omitted in-memory interpretation does not mean source file was modified.

spec.charts: Optional shared charts; each creates a ChartDataN sheet

sheet.name: Unique Excel sheet name
sheet.rows: 2D array of primitive cells or cell objects
sheet.header: boolean, default true; applies header-row styling to row 1
sheet.merges: Array of merge objects; overlapping populated cells are rejected

cell.format: header|integer|number|percent|currency|date|wrap|total; date is formatting of Excel serial numbers, not string-to-date conversion
cell.formula: Explicit allowed formula string, mutually used instead of value
cell.cached: string|finite number|boolean; caller-supplied and unverified; absent writes blank cache and marks recalc_pending

native_chart.title: optional text
native_chart.unit: optional Y-axis title for non-pie charts; not a number format
native_chart.anchor: optional Excel cell such as H2 (default H2)
native_chart.series: Array of 1..20 native_series objects; unknown fields are rejected

excel.limits: New files only. No existing workbook rewriting; no formula evaluation, macros or external links. No implicit stacked/secondary-axis options. Unknown fields are rejected at every spec/object level. Native pie requires one series.

merge.range: [r1,c1,r2,c2], zero-based inclusive within supplied rows; must span at least 2 cells
merge.value: optional text, default empty string; replaces upper-left value

validation.values: nonempty string array; total literal list length including separators <=255 characters; list validation only; commas and double quotes within individual values are rejected

native_series.name: optional literal text, not an Excel formula
native_series.categories: [sheet,r1,c1,r2,c2], zero-based inclusive one-dimensional range within supplied data; scatter X requires numeric values or explicit numeric formula caches
native_series.values: same format as categories and same length; scatter uses categories as X and values as Y; values must be numbers, blanks or pending formulas; pie requires known nonnegative numbers with positive total

excel.formula_functions: SUM AVERAGE MIN MAX COUNT COUNTA COUNTIF COUNTIFS SUMIF SUMIFS IF IFS IFERROR AND OR NOT ROUND ROUNDUP ROUNDDOWN ABS MOD INT SUBTOTAL SUMPRODUCT INDEX MATCH XLOOKUP VLOOKUP HLOOKUP LEFT RIGHT MID LEN TRIM CONCAT CONCATENATE TEXT DATE YEAR MONTH DAY EOMONTH TODAY

resource_limits.generation: 1..50 total sheets, <=100000 rectangular data cells, <=20 native charts per sheet, <=20 shared charts
resource_limits.inspection: 64 MiB archive, 128 MiB total expansion, 32 MiB per part, <=5000 members, <=200000 stored cells plus merged expansion, <=100 worksheets

excel.not_generated: Pivot tables, macros, embedded pictures, external links, stacked/combined/secondary-axis/date-axis charts, hidden sheets and existing-template edits are not generated. Their inspection support does not imply generation or fidelity support.

section_fields.sources: items:[{id,title,publisher?,date?,note?,url?}]; unique ASCII ids; URL optional http(s) without credentials; never fetched or verified by engine

html.wide_tables: Tables with more than eight columns keep horizontal keyboard scrolling on screen and print as labeled records to retain every field.
html.unknown_fields: Rejected at spec, section, chart, series, KPI, timeline, board column, card and source levels; unsupported intent is never silently ignored.
html.examples: Use office_capabilities(topic=html, example=SCENARIO) for a complete runnable example.

args.output: new project-relative evidence directory; existing parent

validation.mode: JavaScript disabled; offline; all requests aborted; Chromium sandbox explicitly requested with no downgrade. Fresh browser-context isolation, not OS sandbox. Embedded iframe/frame/object/embed tags conservatively rejected before parsing.
validation.artifacts: report.evidence filenames under evidence_directory; screenshot/PDF visual review required
validation.print: Default and open states each get separate layout budgets. Evidence PDF forced A4, 1-25 pages; reaching cap or uncertain page-object count is limited, never complete/pass. Native print pagination still needs visual review.

shared_chart.title: text
shared_chart.semantics: bar is vertical in both outputs; pie requires exactly one nonnegative series with positive sum

outputs: Project-relative new filenames only; parent directory exists. Spec/options passed to tools as JSON strings. Always inspect generated Excel and run HTML QA before final delivery.
not_supported: PPT conversion (existing user skill remains separate)
